round: R1 full-albedo indigo woven cloth candidate

source_identity.author: Microsoft
source_identity.scope: Selected original technical-fabric maps adapted to blue; no model geometry downloaded and no historical silk authenticity finding.

review_method: All eight unedited full native framebuffers were individually viewed with view_image detail=original; three derived maps also viewed. No diagnostic crop, contact sheet, generated image or altered raw frame used. Coordinates are zero-based in 1280x960 raw frames.

capture_contract.frames_per_pair: Frozen three-quarter front pose, identical recorded camera and light/exposure

findings.subject: Lower gloss with color/ornament regression
findings.finding: The diagonal sash loses broad white glossy streaks, but deep navy becomes brighter royal/periwinkle blue. The front blue drape loses most gold lotus-like albedo motifs and shows a low-contrast repeated blue diamond/oval pattern; gold trim and sparse separate gold accents remain. This trades authored ornament and dark cloth identity for a flatter technical-fabric look.
findings.sample: At sash pixel (658,331), day RGB changes [24,31,80] to [57,82,163]; night [16,25,75] to [49,74,158]. RGB samples support visible brightening, not isolated roughness measurement.

findings.subject: Weave/normal readability
findings.finding: Near front drape has visible large repeated blue cells; fine weave and normal relief are difficult to distinguish from albedo. The sash remains visually broad and smooth. At Confluence mid distance, fine fabric detail cannot be judged; reduced highlights and brighter blue dominate. No isolated normal/roughness render exists, so normal-map correctness or a material-specific cause cannot be proven from these combined frames.

findings.subject: Fixed-view seams and lighting
findings.finding: No new gross silhouette split or conspicuous bright UV seam is visible in this three-quarter frozen view. Existing angular hems, panel overlaps/notches and stiff folds remain. Day/night pairs preserve the same spatial material change; night cloth stays conspicuously blue. Other views, motion, contact and temporal shimmer are untested.

findings.subject: Bounded capture/material ownership contract
findings.finding: Independent file hashes and direct JSON state comparisons confirm equal recorded pair cameras/lights, identical rig/bone/mesh/skin/morph/controller/nonowned-material states after removal of only the 15 exact owned target uniforms, exactly three target material instances changed, unchanged secondary_offset and exact full restoration. State-hash equality is checked as recorded; the reviewer does not independently recompute Godot JSON serialization hash.

supported_next_correction: Preserve original authored indigo/ornament albedo (base_color, base_texture and use_base_texture), evaluate candidate roughness/normal separately through the same bounded fixture, then produce a separately identified matched R2 capture. Do not overwrite R1 evidence.
remaining_issues: Solid-looking hair, glossy/stylized skin response, restrained face expression, anatomy, angular drape and silhouette limitations remain visible and unchanged by this material fixture.
No continuous animation/deformation/contact, unseen UV seams, temporal shimmer, normal-isolation, listening or human gameplay-feel review.
No physical-GPU profiling or real-time performance result; llvmpipe software Vulkan captured fixed frames.
No commercial-game/AAA parity, finished-art, KHR_sheen equivalence, game-default adoption or release acceptance.
